chapter.title: Mining Basics
chapter.summary: Scan, fracture and extract: how ship mining works.

objectives.title: Mine your first rock
objectives.why: Ship mining has three phases: scanning, fracturing and extraction. This walks through one rock.

steps.do: In a mining ship, near an asteroid cluster or a planet or moon surface, press Tab for Scanning Mode.
Hold the left mouse button about two seconds and release to send a pulse. Pinging also reveals you to nearby ships.
Pick a rock and press M for Mining Mode. Aim at the rock to read its composition, resistance and instability.
steps.done_when: The HUD shows the rock's details.

steps.do: Make sure you're in Fracture Mode (right-click toggles), then left-click to fire the laser. It starts at a low throttle.
steps.done_when: The laser is on the rock.

steps.do: Scroll up slowly to raise the Laser Throttle until the Rock Energy Level enters the Green Zone, and hold it there without overcharging.
steps.done_when: The Fracturing Sensor reaches 100% and the rock breaks.

steps.do: Right-click to Extraction Mode and left-click purple-glowing fragments to pull them in. Yellow ones need fracturing again.
steps.done_when: Your ore bags hold the extracted material.
